rv.q: As Finnigan recounts the everywoman’s struggles, sepia-tinted video designed by Hayley Egan and keening music composed by Reuben Ingall augment his words.

A phone camera is set to record across a black tablecloth-laden table on one side and a second table hosts a computer set to operate the projector onto the large blank screen at the back of the space (video design by Hayley Egan). A repurposed wall flat sits next to this table with a large panel of brown paper and a large sharpie.
